acceptanceCriteria: a test drives the ordinary fallback through validEnvelope and fails if the declared hostVersion is not accepted
the suspicion is confirmed or refuted with a built-image run, recorded in the ticket
body:
Suspected defect, not reproduced. The lsp-editor-pi batch lane (2026-10-21, while fixing V1-0448) read integrations/pi-protected runtime.ts passing version '0.85.1' to the ordinary runner, while the Pi runtime's validEnvelope accepts only hostVersion '0.99.1'. If both hold in the built SEA image, every ordinary fallback faults and the V1-0448 shared-budget fallback never succeeds.
Reproduction needed: a built pi-protected image (build/release/pi-protected) driven into the fallback path.
Expected: the fallback's declared host version matches the envelope's accepted set, with a test that fails on a mismatch.
title: Suspected: pi-protected ordinary fallback passes hostVersion 0.85.1 but the Pi runtime envelope accepts only 0.99.1
